title: {Syn} FunSearch Paired LLMs With Program Search
content:
FunSearch used large language models to propose programs and an automated evaluator to score them. The loop searched for code that improved mathematical or algorithmic objectives.

This matters because the evaluator grounds creativity: generated programs are not just prose claims, they have to run and score well.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
